sections.title: Investment Recommendation
sections.text: Visa’s business durability is underscored by an operating margin near sixty percent [[V.ratio.operating_margin]], reflecting strong pricing power and efficient cost structure. The firm also benefits from a solid return on equity and moderate leverage. However, the filing notes that higher client incentives are eroding margin growth [source:K:L839][source:E:L44]. If the operating margin were to decline markedly or incentive spending accelerated, the view would shift to a lower rating.

insight.text: Visa generates a very high return on equity.
